_comment: Byte-patch signatures the patcher reads at runtime (next to the exe, or the current dir). Per site: sig is hex from the cmp, the jump byte is at jgOff, and it must match exactly expectedMatches times. Add builds with scripts/derive_milestone.py; details in mv2-reversing.md.

sites._comment: Real Chrome blocks off-store extensions ('not from the Web Store') and greys out Enable. Flips the from-webstore check to always-yes, so they install and stay on -- no 'managed by your organization' banner. Branded Chrome only.
